answer.reason: The verses tell Saul's story at length, so a line of four chief deeds fits.

clauses.quote: slew the Ammonites until the heat of the day

clauses.english: was rejected by the LORD from being king
clauses.quote: the LORD hath rejected thee from being king over Israel

clauses.english: sought day after day to kill David
fell on his own sword on mount Gilboa
clauses.quote: Saul took a sword, and fell upon it
